name: rust-ext-review-toolkit
description: Review toolkit for Python extensions written in Rust with PyO3. 13 specialized agents covering unsafe-block soundness, PyResult propagation, GIL discipline, panic safety, #[pyclass] trait bounds and protocol correctness, module init, lifetime handles, PyO3 version compatibility, complexity, and git history. Tree-sitter-rust-powered.

plugins.name: rust-ext-review-toolkit
plugins.description: 13 specialized agents and 4 commands for analyzing PyO3 Rust extensions. Tree-sitter-rust scripts detect unsafe-block soundness violations, panics crossing the FFI boundary, swallowed PyResults, #[pyclass] Send/Sync gaps, missing __traverse__/__clear__, and PyO3 version-migration debt. Includes a 'migrate' command for the Bound-API and free-threading migration checklist.
